title: Call on the GM
description: A call on the GM (DEL-30..33, ADR 0005): a pending proposal, a surfaced exception, a ceiling refusal (DEL-20) or a rules discrepancy (RUL-17), stored as YAML in `calls/<id, six digits>.yaml` of the campaign workspace. Protocol version 0.1.0. The Core gives it a deadline and applies its safe default when the deadline passes; Surfaces only display it (ARC-11).

id.description: Increasing, unique among the workspace's calls.

at.description: Real time the call was raised.

moment.description: The moment the call was raised in.

session.description: The live session's id (moment.yaml), null outside a live session.

blocking.description: Whether it blocks the current turn or scene, as the acting agent or its job declared it.

deadline.description: now when blocking, otherwise the next break, unless the delegation table cell's deadline mode forces one (DEL-30, DEL-07). A job's call inherits the job's deadline (ARC-28).

interruption.description: Due now during a live session: shown to the GM without the GM asking (DEL-33, MET-06). A call held for the break is not one.

entry.description: A proposal's pending action log entry, or a ceiling refusal's failed one.

job.description: The job the call comes from, if any.

message.description: An exception's, a ceiling refusal's or a discrepancy's text, or why the Core held a proposal at propose whatever the level (a wrap's contradiction or blocking question, CAP-10).

status.description: answered when the GM approved or rejected the proposal; defaulted when its deadline passed first: a proposal is rejected, an exception takes no action, logged as a `safe_default` action log entry (DEL-32). A blocking call forced to break is defaulted at once (DEL-31). withdrawn when an entity override of its acting entity (the proposal's action entry, else its job's entity) landed first: the same safe default, logged with the override, and never shown at the break (DEL-16).

shown.description: Whether a defaulted call was shown again at a break.

check.description: A discrepancy only: the kind of rules check that failed, what a house rule silences (RUL-24).

observation.description: A discrepancy only: the checked observation's locator, observations/<session>.jsonl#<id>.
